transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the state attorney general has requested a written response regarding our subscription-renewal and cancellation practices, and we have a draft prepared but not yet submitted. Before I approve the response package for submission, I need each of your teams to report any facts that should affect what we send. Regulatory, compliance, finance, and product operations — please share anything relevant from your areas so we can make sure our response is accurate and complete.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important from my review this week. I examined the attorney general's proposed resolution form and the applicable state statute, and because this inquiry concerns automatic renewals, our response must be filed as an Assurance of Voluntary Compliance and must contain an express no-admission clause. I hadn't circulated this yet because the draft form arrived after our response draft was already prepared, but this needs to be addressed before we submit.

This restitution data needs to be incorporated into the response package before we submit it to the attorney general.

I tested the subscription platform after reviewing the affected flow and confirmed that the compliant opt-in renewal change can be deployed for New Jersey subscribers only. Importantly, applying it nationally would interrupt 17,642 unaffected subscriptions. I documented the deployment result in a product ticket this morning, but it has not yet been attached to the legal response package. This should be incorporated before we submit to the attorney general.
